tasks.label: Android toolchain diagnostics
args: $names = @('adb','gradle','java'); foreach ($name in $names) { $cmd = Get-Command $name -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($null -eq $cmd) { Write-Output ($name + ': NOT FOUND') } else { Write-Output ($name + ': ' + $cmd.Source) } }; if (Get-Command adb -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { adb devices -l }
